messages:
Zoe: Quick micro-poll: espresso :coffee: or iced coffee :cup_with_straw:? Reply with emoji and drop a one-liner. Winner buys the office snack tomorrow.
Ben: :coffee: One-liner: "I measure time in espresso shots."
Lila: :cup_with_straw: One-liner: "Cold coffee, warm heart." Also brought mini shortbread on my desk, help yourselves.
Raj: :coffee: Gotta be awake for the 2pm sync. Also shoutout to Lila for the cookies :clap:.
Nina: :cup_with_straw: Iced because my laptop thinks 70F is a sauna.
Zoe: Tally so far: espresso 2, iced 2. Tie breaker: which snack wins? shortbread vs granola bar.
Ben: shortbread. Solid, crumbly, diplomatic.
Lila: granola bars are for people who like algebra. shortbread team for vibes.
Raj: shortbread for the win.
OpsBot: FYI: Thermostat set to 72F at 10:00 — if anyone needs it lower/higher file a ticket at <https://intranet/infra/thermostat>.
Nina: One-liner: "If the plant survives your week, you deserve a medal." Also kudos to Raj for rescuing the ficus last month.
Zoe: Poll result: espresso 2, iced 2, snack tie broken by reactions -> shortbread wins. Lila: hero of the hour.
Lila: I will accept my shortbread crown humbly. Also I vote espresso personally.
Ben: OK espresso team, claim your victory by picking up a token shortbread from Lila's desk.
Raj: Quick logistics: whos walking to the bodega at 3? I can go if someone covers the snack fund.
Nina: Ill Venmo. One-liner: "Walking to the bodega is cardio and democracy."
Zoe: Thanks all. Tiny, perfect thread. Keep the one-liners coming — they power our Monday. :sparkles:
